scope: Actual shared overlay controller/storage and metadata snapshot helpers with a bounded relocation collaborator; no browser, pixels, native, hardware or reference acceptance.

checks.name: Typed preset draft is the default MIDI save name
Empty typed name refuses save without replacing existing presets
Same-layer render and route retain a typed draft; selecting a new layer resets its name
Text and image draft names remain independent
Metadata snapshot restores typed and empty draft names without enabling images
Draft validation refuses unsupported kinds and oversized values without changing metadata
